title: Mixing: So Glad To See You Here by Wings | 1979
content:
Replica Studio, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

The song ‘So Glad To See You Here’ was mixed in stereo for Wings’ seventh studio album Back To The Egg on 26 March 1979.

This day’s work remained unused, however, and more mixes were created on 27 and 30 March.
